title: {{NAME}} and the Broken Rainbow Bridge
moral: When we work together, we can fix anything.

pages.content:
{{NAME}} walked into a glowing meadow.
Colourful fairies flew all around him.
A silver robot beeped near a tall hill.
A white unicorn stood by a broken bridge.
The rainbow bridge had lost all its colours.

pages.content:
A tiny fairy named Pip flew to {{NAME}}.
"The bridge broke this morning," said Pip.
{{NAME}}'s eyes went wide with surprise.
"Oh no!" he said. "The unicorns need it!"
His mouth dropped open in surprise.

pages.content:
The rainbow bridge shone again.
All the unicorns clip-clopped across it.
Pip gave {{NAME}} a tiny hug.
"Thank you for helping," she said.
{{NAME}} smiled and closed his sleepy eyes.
Goodnight, {{NAME}}. Sleep tight.
In the morning, maybe Pip will have a new secret to share.
